SIGNALS.observation: The Piacenza and Parma bulletins of 21 August 2026 restate two acetamiprid derogations on sugar beet: one of 29 April 2026 naming the commercial products KESTREL and EPIK SL for aphid control on sugar beet, allowed only from 28 April to 25 AUGUST 2026, and one of 30 April 2026 for aphids on sugar-beet and brassica seed crops (that second one still restated in the 2 September 2026 FCRR bulletin). The KESTREL/EPIK window closed four days after this bulletin and nine days before the 2026-09-03 reference date.

SIGNALS.adama_relation: LABEL PAIR + REGULATORY EVENT. ADAMA holds 16 BARBABIETOLA × AFIDI label rows in productRelationships (IT-LBL-107/108, 200/201, 387, 515/516, 708/709, 828, 908, 1077/1078, 1165/1166, 1889) across KLARTAN 20 EW, KLARTAN SMART, TAU AL 240 EW, MAVRIK SMART, MAVRIK EW, MAVRIK JET, EVURE PRO (tau-fluvalinate) and LAMDEX EXTRA, FORZA, NINJA (lambda-cyhalothrin) — the same product set carried by OPP_9AB924CA36C8 (O2_MARKET_MOMENT, CROP_SUGAR_BEET, GEO_ITALY). The derogation is competitor chemistry on the same crop and the same target, and its commercial-crop window has now expired.
SIGNALS.proves: That Emilia-Romagna judged the registered aphid toolbox on sugar beet insufficient enough to grant two acetamiprid emergency authorisations in April 2026, that KESTREL and EPIK SL were the products named, and that the commercial-crop window ran only to 25/08/2026.
SIGNALS.does_not_prove: It does NOT prove that aphid pressure was actually high in August (no bulletin in the window reports an aphid observation on beet — the only 'AFIDI: si segnalano basse presenze' line I found is FAGIOLINO, a different crop). It does not prove any ADAMA product was considered, offered or sold, and it does not prove growers will switch to tau-fluvalinate or lambda-cyhalothrin. These same bulletins flag Lambdacialotrina with '(*) Sostanza attiva Candidata alla Sostituzione', which constrains one half of ADAMA's beet-aphid label set.
SIGNALS.NARROWED_CLAIM_AFTER_REFUTATION:
Regione Emilia-Romagna, Bollettino di produzione integrata e biologica Piacenza N° 27 del 21/08/2026 (live: HTTP 200, 1011054 bytes, application/pdf) states verbatim: "In data 29 aprile 2026 è stata concessa la deroga valida per il territorio della Regione Emilia-Romagna per l'impiego dei prodotti fitosanitari KESTREL® ed EPIK® SL (s.a. acetamiprid) per il controllo delle infestazioni di afidi sulla coltura della barbabietola da zucchero - impiego consentito dal 28 aprile 2026 fino al 25 agosto 2026." The same bulletin also restates a second derogation, granted 30 April 2026, for the active substance acetamiprid against aphids on SEED crops of sugar beet and cabbages ("sulle colture da seme di barbabietola da zucchero e cavoli"), which names no commercial product and states no window. Both sentences appear in the Parma N° 27 del 21/08/2026 bulletin (HTTP 200, 885199 bytes; the first split across a page header) and in both N° 26 bulletins of 07/08/2026; the 30 April seed-crop entry is still restated in the Forlì-Cesena/Ravenna/Rimini bulletin of 02/09/2026, where the KESTREL/EPIK sugar-beet entry does not appear. The KESTREL/EPIK commercial-crop window closed on 25/08/2026, four days after this bulletin and eight days before the package reference date of 2026-09-02 (referenceDate.json).

What this proves: that the Region granted, and its bulletins keep restating, two acetamiprid derogations touching sugar beet — one naming KESTREL and EPIK SL for the commercial crop with a 28/04–25/08/2026 window, one for sugar-beet and brassica seed crops — valid for the whole regional territory. It does NOT prove why the Region granted them: the bulletin records the grant and gives no reasoning, so "the registered toolbox was judged insufficient" is inference, not text. The bulletin also does not use the words "emergency authorisation" for the 29 April entry; it says "deroga".

ADAMA relation (LABEL PAIR, competitor chemistry): acetamiprid is absent from activeIngredients.json, productsRegulatory.json and productActiveIngredients.json, and KESTREL and EPIK match nothing on word boundary in either ADAMA registry — the derogated products are not ADAMA's. Separately, productRelationships.json holds exactly 16 BARBABIETOLA × AFIDI label rows (IT-LBL-107/108, 200/201, 387, 515/516, 708/709, 828, 908, 1077/1078, 1165/1166, 1889), all EVIDENCE_DOCUMENTED, LINK_STRENGTH BLOCO_DA_CULTURA or LINHA_DA_TABELA (genuine on-crop label authorisation, not product-spectrum inference), across KLARTAN 20 EW, KLARTAN SMART, TAU AL 240 EW, MAVRIK SMART, MAVRIK EW, MAVRIK JET and EVURE PRO (tau-fluvalinate; MAVRIK JET is tau-fluvalinate + pirimicarb) and LAMDEX EXTRA, FORZA and NINJA (lambda-cyhalothrin) — all ten with AUTHORIZATION_HOLDER "ADAMA ITALIA S.R.L.". These ten are a SUBSET of, not the same set as, the twelve products carried by OPP_9AB924CA36C8, which also lists LEBRON 0.5 G, OLIONET and SCHERMO 0.5 G, whose IDENTITY_KEY is NO_TARGET, and whose evidence rows IT-LBL-109..112 are NOTTUE, ALTICHE and NAO_MAPEADO, not aphids. The derogation is competitor chemistry on the same crop and the same target as those label rows. It is a regulatory event in one region on the dates the document states; it is not evidence of infestation incidence, of demand, or of anything about Italy outside Emilia-Romagna.

SIGNALS.observation: Reggio Emilia (06/08/2026) and Modena (04/08/2026) record cercospora presence as MODEST at the fittone-growth-to-maturation stage and instruct growers to continue the defence with copper products or copper+sulphur mixtures. Across all 14 bulletins read (04/08 → 01/09/2026, all six interprovincial areas) the barbabietola cercospora entry never names a conventional fungicide — only 'Sali di rame' / 'Prodotti rameici' optionally mixed with sulphur, and only on late-lifting stands. The same bulletins carry the EU copper re-approval note capping cumulative copper at 28 kg/ha over 7 years (Reg UE 2025/1489).

SIGNALS.adama_relation: LABEL PAIR + EU REGULATORY. ADAMA has exactly ONE barbabietola × cercospora label row in the entire radar: IT-LBL-409, SPYRALE, Ministero registration 009757, label quote 'Barbabietola da zucchero Cercosporiosi (Cercospora beticola) Oidio (Erysiphe betae) … 2 trattamenti ad intervalli di 21 giorni'. SPYRALE is difenoconazole + fenpropidin, and fenpropidin is precisely the substance of OPP_2BDE8FC566CE (O5_REGULATORY_PREPARATION, CROP_SUGAR_BEET, EU limit date 2027-05-15, PRODUTOS_ADAMA 1).
SIGNALS.proves: That the Emilia-Romagna service recorded modest cercospora presence on sugar beet in Reggio Emilia and Modena in early August 2026, and recommended continuing with copper (± sulphur) on late-lifting stands — a recommendation it maintained through at least 1 September 2026 in all six areas.
SIGNALS.does_not_prove: It does NOT prove that SPYRALE was recommended: SPYRALE is not named in any of the 14 bulletins (I word-boundary-checked all 186 ADAMA commercial and regulatory product names against all 14 texts). It does not prove SPYRALE could legally be used at this phenological stage — I did not read its pre-harvest interval. SPYRALE is a Ministero registration held by ADAMA, NOT one of the 51 commercial-catalogue products. 'Presenza modesta' is explicitly low pressure, and two provinces are not Italy.
SIGNALS.NARROWED_CLAIM_AFTER_REFUTATION: Regione Emilia-Romagna's Bollettino di produzione integrata e biologica recorded modest cercospora presence on sugar beet in two interprovincial bulletins of round N°26 in early August 2026: Reggio Emilia N°26 del 06/08/2026 and Modena N°26 del 04/08/2026, both stating verbatim 'BARBABIETOLA DA ZUCCHERO Fase fenologica: accrescimento fittone-maturazione Difesa Cercospora: presenza della malattia modesta. Proseguire la difesa intervenendo con Prodotti rameici o miscele di rame e Zolfo.' In those two documents the instruction is UNRESTRICTED, it carries no late-lifting qualifier; the 'varieta ad estirpo tardivo' / 'impianti a cavatura tardiva' restriction appears in the other areas' entries (Parma, Piacenza, Bologna-Ferrara, Forli-Cesena/Ravenna/Rimini) and in the later Reggio N°27 (20/08), Modena N°27 (18/08) and Modena N°28 (01/09). Across the 14 bulletins read (04/08 to 02/09/2026, six interprovincial areas), 13 carry a barbabietola cercospora entry and none of them names a conventional fungicide: only 'Sali di rame' / 'Prodotti rameici', optionally in mixture with sulphur. The fourteenth (Forli-Cesena, Ravenna, Rimini N°28 del 02/09/2026) has no barbabietola cercospora entry at all, so the recommendation is documented as continuing to 01/09/2026 only for Modena; for the other four areas the latest bulletin in this reading is 19-21 August. The same bulletins carry the EU copper re-approval note (Reg UE 2025/1489, authorisation extended to 2029, cumulative application not to exceed 28 kg copper per hectare over 7 years). ADAMA relation, label authorisation not portfolio: IT-LBL-409 is the single barbabietola x cercospora label row in the radar, SPYRALE (IT-PRD-016), Ministero registration 009757, holder ADAMA ITALIA S.R.L., difenoconazole + fenpropidin, crop and target on the same row of the use table; fenpropidin is the substance of OPP_2BDE8FC566CE (O5_REGULATORY_PREPARATION, CROP_SUGAR_BEET, EU limit date 2027-05-15, PRODUTOS_ADAMA 1). This is a bulletin recommendation plus a label pair and an EU approval date. It is not evidence of cercospora incidence beyond these two provinces, not evidence of a trend across Italy, and not evidence of demand for any product.

The systemic list present on 18–21 August (cymoxanil, metalaxyl-M, azoxystrobin, folpet, fluazinam, captan) does not appear in these two documents.

SIGNALS.adama_relation: TIMING, on the same crop-and-target as an existing opportunity. The six ADAMA cymoxanil products holding POMODORO × peronospora label rows (DAUPHIN 45, BADGER 45% WG, CARSON 45% WG, ANTERLEX, MOXYL MK, VANTEX — the product set of OPP_EA2AE1EFB775) sit behind an active that the regional service stops listing for this crop at the start of September. The window for that chemistry in ER processing tomato is closing for the 2026 season.
SIGNALS.proves: That on 1–2 September 2026 the Emilia-Romagna service directed processing-tomato growers to copper alone for pre-harvest cover, in two of its six interprovincial areas.
SIGNALS.does_not_prove: It does NOT prove that cymoxanil was withdrawn, restricted or advised against — the shorter entry is fully consistent with an ordinary end-of-season pre-harvest-interval note. Absence of the systemic list in MY READING of the extracted text is absence in my reading, not absence in the printed bulletin. The other four interprovincial areas had not published an N° 28 bulletin at the time of collection, so I cannot say what they recommend: NAO_SEI.
SIGNALS.NARROWED_CLAIM_AFTER_REFUTATION: In the two Emilia-Romagna interprovincial bulletins published on 1-2 September 2026 — Forli-Cesena/Ravenna/Rimini N°28 del 02/09/2026 (HTTP 200, 822062 bytes) and Modena N°28 del 01/09/2026 (HTTP 200, 990415 bytes) — the POMODORO DA INDUSTRIA defence section, in both the integrated and the organic part, is reduced to a single Peronospora line that names copper alone (Prodotti rameici / sali di rame), described as "attivi anche contro le batteriosi e l'alternariosi", for cover on late transplants through harvest. In the immediately previous bulletins for the same crop (FCRR 19/08, Modena 18/08, Reggio 20/08, Bologna-Ferrara 19/08, Parma and Piacenza 21/08) that same paragraph also named cover products (Folpet, Captano, Fluazinam) and systemics (Metalaxil-M, Propamocarb only in mixture with Cimoxanil, Oxathiapiprolin, Mandipropamide, Ametoctradina, Azoxistrobin, Pyraclostrobin, Zoxamide, Cyazofamide, Amisulbron), with Cimoxanil (max 3) as the curative option. Those actives are absent from the TOMATO section of the two September documents — but not from the documents, where metalaxil-M, fluazinam and captano still appear for other crops (sugar-beet seed crop, walnut and hazelnut deroghe, apple scab). This is what two of the six interprovincial areas published; the other four had not issued a September bulletin as of 03/09/2026 (Bologna-Ferrara index live-checked, still ending at N°27 del 19/08/2026), so it is not established that the regional service as a whole has dropped that chemistry. ADAMA relation is TIMING only: six ADAMA ITALIA S.R.L. cymoxanil products — DAUPHIN 45, BADGER 45% WG, CARSON 45% WG, ANTERLEX, MOXYL MK, VANTEX — hold documented POMODORO x PERONOSPORA label rows (IT-LBL-969, 1448, 1453, 1737, 1743, 1749) and are the product set of OPP_EA2AE1EFB775, whose geography is REGION_VENETO, not Emilia-Romagna. These two bulletins prove what the phytosanitary service wrote for this crop on these two dates. They do not prove incidence, affected area, demand, that growers will treat, or that the cymoxanil window in ER processing tomato is closing for the 2026 season — no document says that; it is an inference. NAO_SEI what Parma, Piacenza, Reggio and Bologna-Ferrara will write in their N°28.

SIGNALS.observation: Parma and Piacenza report sporadic alternaria symptoms in processing-tomato fields on 07/08 and again on 21/08/2026, note that several widely grown hybrids carry only intermediate resistance to Alternaria solani, and list three ADAMA-held actives among the dual peronospora/alternaria options: azoxystrobin (Max 2), fluxapyroxad (Max 2) and difenoconazole (Max 2). Reggio, Modena, Bologna-Ferrara and FCRR describe only predisposing conditions, not symptoms.
SIGNALS.citation: Alternaria: rilevati sporadici sintomi in campo. Nella difesa è opportuno tener presente che, alcuni ibridi piuttosto diffusi, presentano resistenza intermedia ad Alternaria solani. Orientando la difesa verso ibridi più suscettibili, è consigliabile scegliere prodotti che abbiano una efficacia duplice nei confronti di peronospora e alternaria, come Pyraclostrobin, Azoxystrobin (Max 2), Zoxamide (Max 4), Fluxapiroxad (Max 2), Difenconazolo (Max 2), Cyflufenamid (solo in miscela con Difenconazolo).

SIGNALS.adama_relation: ACTIVE INGREDIENT. All three are ADAMA-held: AI_AZOXYSTROBIN (BLAISE ULTRA, CUSTODIA ULTRA, KOJAMI, MAXENTIS, MIRADOR TURBO), AI_FLUXAPYROXAD (AVASTEL), AI_DIFENOCONAZOLE (MAGANIC, SPYRALE). Three ADAMA azoxystrobin+tebuconazole products do carry POMODORO on label — CUSTODIA ULTRA (015232), BLAISE ULTRA (017358), MIRADOR TURBO (017824) — and they are in the product set of OPP_314CBAE48A5C.
SIGNALS.proves: That sporadic alternaria symptoms were observed in Parma and Piacenza processing tomato in August 2026, that widely grown hybrids have only intermediate resistance, and that the service lists azoxystrobin, fluxapyroxad and difenoconazole among the dual-efficacy options, each capped at 2 treatments.
SIGNALS.does_not_prove: It does NOT prove ADAMA holds a tomato-alternaria authorisation. PORTFOLIO RELATION IS NOT LABEL AUTHORIZATION: the POMODORO rows of CUSTODIA ULTRA, BLAISE ULTRA and MIRADOR TURBO are OIDIO rows (Leveillula taurica, Sphaerotheca, Erysiphe), not alternaria; AVASTEL (fluxapyroxad) has no label rows at all in the radar; MAGANIC's difenoconazole rows are cereals only. 'Sporadic symptoms' in two provinces is not an outbreak, and it is not demand.
SIGNALS.NARROWED_CLAIM_AFTER_REFUTATION: The Emilia-Romagna integrated/organic production bulletins for Parma N° 27 and Piacenza N° 27 of 21/08/2026, under the crop heading POMODORO DA INDUSTRIA, state verbatim: "Alternaria: rilevati sporadici sintomi in campo. Nella difesa è opportuno tener presente che, alcuni ibridi piuttosto diffusi, presentano resistenza intermedia ad Alternaria solani. Orientando la difesa verso ibridi più suscettibili, è consigliabile scegliere prodotti che abbiano una efficacia duplice nei confronti di peronospora e alternaria, come Pyraclostrobin, Azoxystrobin (Max 2), Zoxamide (Max 4), Fluxapiroxad (Max 2), Difenconazolo (Max 2), Cyflufenamid (solo in miscela con Difenconazolo)." The Parma N° 26 and Piacenza N° 26 bulletins of 07/08/2026 carry a LONGER variant of the same advisory (adding a sentence on high temperatures and basal-leaf senescence as predisposing factors) with the identical actives list and identical Max caps — substantively the same guidance, not a verbatim identical passage. In the same reporting window Reggio Emilia (20/08), Bologna-Ferrara (19/08), Forlì-Cesena/Ravenna/Rimini (19/08) and Modena (18/08) describe only "possibili condizioni predisponenti", with no symptoms reported. Source re-verified live this session: Parma N° 27 PDF HTTP 200, 885199 bytes, application/pdf; Piacenza N° 27 PDF HTTP 200, 1011054 bytes. What this proves: a public regional advisory service reported sporadic Alternaria symptoms in processing tomato in Parma and Piacenza on 07/08 and 21/08/2026, noted intermediate resistance in some widely grown hybrids, and listed six dual peronospora/alternaria actives each with a per-season cap. ADAMA relation is ACTIVE INGREDIENT (portfolio) ONLY: three of the six listed actives — azoxystrobin, fluxapyroxad and difenoconazole — are ADAMA-held actives in the canonical registry (AI_AZOXYSTROBIN in BLAISE ULTRA, CUSTODIA ULTRA, KOJAMI, MAXENTIS, MIRADOR TURBO; AI_FLUXAPYROXAD in AVASTEL; AI_DIFENOCONAZOLE in MAGANIC, SPYRALE). This is NOT label authorisation for the situation the bulletin describes. CUSTODIA ULTRA (015232), BLAISE ULTRA (017358) and MIRADOR TURBO (017824) do carry POMODORO on label, but the label target for that crop is OIDIO, not alternaria; no ADAMA product in the corpus holds a POMODORO + ALTERNARIA label use (the only ALTERNARIA label relations recorded are BANJO, EMBRACE and AGHARTA on MELO and PERO for Alternaria mali); and the ADAMA fluxapyroxad and difenoconazole products (AVASTEL, MAGANIC, SPYRALE) hold no tomato label relation at all. The three azoxystrobin+tebuconazole products are in the product set of OPP_314CBAE48A5C, which is an O4_COMPETITIVE_OPENING on CROP_TOMATO at GEO_ITALY with NO_TARGET — it is not an alternaria opportunity. This is one advisory service in two provinces on two dates: it is not evidence of incidence, of an Italy-wide situation, or of demand.

SIGNALS.observation: Parma reports on 21 August 2026 that adult Helicoverpa trap catches are declining and no eggs or larvae are found on the vegetation, but holes are present in the fruit; above the threshold of 2 plants with eggs or larvae out of 30 checked per plot, chlorantraniliprole (Max 2) is listed first among the intervention options for late transplants.
SIGNALS.citation: Nottua gialla: le catture di adulti nelle trappole di monitoraggio sono in diminuzione. Non si rilevano uova e larve sulla vegetazione, ma fori nei frutti. In caso di catture di adulti, effettuare i monitoraggi visivi sulla vegetazione e, superata la soglia di intervento (2 piante con presenza di uova o larve su 30 piante controllate per appezzamento), è possibile intervenire, nei trapianti tardivi, con Clorantraniliprole (Max 2) o Spinosad (Max 3, efficace nei confronti di tripidi) oppure con Bacillus thuringiensis o Virus NPV nottua gialla o Metaflumizone (Max 2, utilizzabile fino al 30/06/2026) o Emamectina(*) (Max 2).

SIGNALS.adama_relation: ACTIVE INGREDIENT ONLY, and weak. AI_CHLORANTRANILIPROLE is in ADAMA Italia's 53 actives; its single product in the radar is COSAYR 200 SC, whose only CROP_ON_LABEL values are MELO and PESCO. There is no ADAMA tomato label pair behind this recommendation, so I attach no opportunity to it.
SIGNALS.proves: That on 21 August 2026 the Parma service recorded declining Helicoverpa adult catches with fruit damage present, and listed chlorantraniliprole first among the above-threshold options on late-transplanted processing tomato.

Captan and fluazinam are generic substances open to any registrant, so calling them "both ADAMA active ingredients" is loose — the recommendation is not ADAMA-specific and is not demand, incidence or field pressure.

The ADAMA relation is separately and correctly verified as LABEL AUTHORISATION, not portfolio: productRelationships.json holds exactly six LABEL_USE_RELATIONSHIP records with CROP_ON_LABEL=MELO and TARGET_ON_LABEL=TICCHIOLATURA, all EVIDENCE_DOCUMENTED, LINK_STRENGTH=BLOCO_DA_CULTURA — IT-LBL-260 MERPAN 80 WDG (008102), IT-LBL-581 CAPTHENE 80 WDG (011500), IT-LBL-787 MAKE UP 80 WDG (012156), all "Venturia spp"; IT-LBL-974 BANJO (013905), IT-LBL-1432 EMBRACE (015315), IT-LBL-1621 AGHARTA (017432), all "Venturia inaequalis". productsRegulatory.json confirms all six are ADAMA-held (ADAMA ITALIA S.R.L. / ADAMA MAKHTESHIM LTD), status Ri-registrato/Autorizzato; productActiveIngredients.json maps the first three to AI_CAPTAN and the last three to AI_FLUAZINAM; both AIs are in activeIngredients.json (EU APPROVED). What this proves: the service listed captan and fluazinam among conditional options against apple scab in those three provinces on that date, and ADAMA holds Italian label authorisations covering MELO × TICCHIOLATURA. It proves nothing about incidence, treated area, farmer intent, demand, or the rest of Italy.

SIGNALS.NARROWED_CLAIM_AFTER_REFUTATION:
Bollettino 26 del 07/08/2026 di Piacenza (Regione Emilia-Romagna, Settore fitosanitario e difesa delle produzioni), page 25 of 55, restates verbatim the 2026 compulsory-control regime set by Determinazione n. 9818 del 20/05/2026: "nei vigneti a conduzione integrata (obbligatoria e volontaria) dovranno essere effettuati almeno 2 trattamenti insetticidi con prodotti fitosanitari autorizzati sulla vite contro Scaphoideus titanus o cicaline in genere; sarà obbligatorio effettuare 3 trattamenti se vengono impiegate sostanze attive ammesse in biologico", with further interventions advised where scafoideo presence is significant.

Four narrowings the original claim skips:

(a) The mandate is formally LOTTA OBBLIGATORIA CONTRO FLAVESCENZA DORATA. The insecticide obligation targets S. titanus as the VECTOR of the disease. The bulletin does also write "La lotta obbligatoria contro Scaphoideus titanus", so the claim's phrasing is defensible, but the legal object is flavescenza dorata containment.

(b) TENSE. At the bulletin's own date (7 August 2026) the compulsory windows had ALREADY CLOSED: 2-treatment regime, first by 18 June and second by 31 July 2026; 3-treatment regime, 15 June / 30 June / 15 July 2026. What is live on 7 August is (i) the Region's on-farm compliance check of Determinazione 9818 at selected wineries, and (ii) the ADVISED further intervention where monitoring still shows the insect — for which the bulletin itself names "Tau-fluvalinate (Max 2)" first among the abbattenti. Call it a restated obligation whose deadlines have expired plus a live advisory, not a requirement in force on that date.

(c) DETERMINAZIONE 9818 WAS NOT READ. Region-wide scope and the treatment counts are taken from the bulletin's restatement. The Determinazione's own text is NOT_REACHED in this verification; I did not fetch it. Note also that the bulletin's territorial qualifiers (zona infestata, zone cuscinetto) are attached in the text to the ESTIRPO obligation, not to the treatment counts.

(d) THE ADAMA SIDE IS LABEL AUTHORISATION ONLY. Six vite labels held by ADAMA ITALIA S.R.L., all tau-fluvalinate, all "Ri-registrato", all expiring 2027-01-31 (EU approval of tau-fluvalinate also expires 2027-01-31): KLARTAN 20 EW 007555, TAU AL 240 EW 007864, MAVRIK SMART 009800, KLARTAN SMART 012023, MAVRIK EW 014190, EVURE PRO 014210. SCAFOIDEO and CICALINE are not two independent label entries — both derive from one label phrase, "Contro cicaline (Empoasca vitis, Scaphoideus titanus)". The Determinazione names neither ADAMA nor tau-fluvalinate; it names a class ("prodotti fitosanitari autorizzati sulla vite contro Scaphoideus titanus o cicaline in genere") that these six labels fall inside. Per the corpus's own guard: this proves neither efficacy, nor recommendation, nor priority, nor demand — the label authorises, nothing more.

SIGNALS.NARROWED_CLAIM_AFTER_REFUTATION:
The Emilia-Romagna interprovincial integrated- and organic-production bulletin no. 26 of 07/08/2026 for Piacenza (Regione Emilia-Romagna, Settore Fitosanitario; date and province printed in the running header; landing page HTTP 200 / 820,259 bytes text/html, PDF at that URL + /@@download/file HTTP 200 / 1,117,561 bytes / 55 pages) states, in the "Scafoideo" paragraph of its VITE section, verbatim: "Tra Etofenprox, Lamdacialotrina e Esfenvalerate Max 1 intervento. Tra Piretrine e Piretroidi Max 4 interventi. (*) Sostanza attiva Candidata alla Sostituzione". The sentence immediately before it, in the same paragraph, reads: "...prodotti abbattenti quali Tau-fluvalinate (Max 2) o Deltametrina (Max 2) o Etofenprox (*) o Lambdacialotrina (*) o Esfenvalerate (*)".

Read strictly, this bulletin (a) FLAGS etofenprox, lambdacialotrina and esfenvalerate with (*) as substances already classified at EU level as Candidates for Substitution — it does not itself classify them, and that status is substance-level, not crop-specific — and (b) IMPOSES, as an integrated-production discipline for vite in Piacenza, a cap of ONE intervention shared among those three, against TWO each for tau-fluvalinate and deltametrina, inside an overall ceiling of FOUR among pyrethrins and pyrethroids.

The same two constraint sentences appear word-for-word in the vite/Scafoideo paragraph of all six week-26 ER bulletins — Piacenza 08-07 and Parma 08-07 (exact contiguous match, including the trailing legend), Bologna-Ferrara 08-05, Reggio Emilia 08-06 and Forlì-Cesena/Ravenna/Rimini 08-05 (same sentences, legend placed before rather than after), and Modena 08-04 (looser wording, no (*) marks). This is a regional integrated-production discipline for the 2026 season, not a label restriction, and it says nothing about Italy as a whole, about infestation incidence, or about demand.

ADAMA relevance, stated without confusing portfolio with authorisation: BOTH capped actives named in that sentence are ADAMA active ingredients. Lambda-cyhalothrin (AI_LAMBDA_CYHALOTHRIN, 5 Italian registrations 008259/013560/013590/015275/017687 = LAMDEX EXTRA, FORZA, NINJA, DURAVIS, ELTIRA) has a VITE label on all five, but SCAFOIDEO is on none of them — their vite targets are TIGNOLE, CICALINE, COCCINIGLIE and ALTICHE on all five, plus AFIDI and NOTTUE on LAMDEX EXTRA, DURAVIS and ELTIRA. Tau-fluvalinate (AI_TAU_FLUVALINATE, 7 Italian registrations) is carried by KLARTAN 20 EW, KLARTAN SMART, MAVRIK EW, MAVRIK JET, MAVRIK SMART, TAU AL 240 EW and EVURE PRO, and six of those carry VITE + SCAFOIDEO explicitly on label. So this paragraph is NOT a constraint on competing pyrethroids: the active the bulletin restricts to one shared intervention and marks (*) is the ADAMA active NOT authorised for this target on vite, while the active it allows twice and does not mark is the ADAMA active that IS. What this proves is what one Emilia-Romagna bulletin printed on 07/08/2026 — not market access, not field pressure, not opportunity.
